meta.note: local simulation, no IBM quota; FakeMarrakesh coupling + real calibration sx_error/readout + T1/T2; UniMind v2→v3 = calibration-weighted SABRE + E_2q_log(-log) + E_idle(depth·invT)
meta.est_2q_model: 1 - exp(-(cz_count*avg_cz + sum(sx_error))) , avg_cz from FakeMarrakesh subgraph edges, sx from snapshot
meta.E_2q_log_model: Σ -log(1 - cz_error) per-gate: cz_count * -log(1-avg_cz) (gate-level, SOTA 2606.12816) + layout-level sum over induced subgraph
meta.E_idle_model: depth * mean(1/T1+1/T2) over layout qubits (Mooney et al. 2405.18785, idle decoherence proxy), T1/T2 from calib_full_e08.json
meta.unimind_design: w(q)=1/(readout+3*sx) 排序取连通子图多候选 -> SABRE 二次优化 -> 与 Default 取优，确保 k>=8 不劣于 Default; v3 adds E_2q_log & E_idle metrics for utility model
